title: Ayzium
description: A mod adding tons of cool tech! Copper & Ayzium both get major buffs compared to vanilla copper. Ayzium is a mod developed for Scepters O' Glory
body:
# Notice

I, Jackie The Coder, quit modding. Because no one thanks me enough or support me to feel like I have made what i should have.

If you wish to have my mods, sorry but you have to support me on patreon or Ko-fi once it's ready.


# Ayzium Mod

*A Minecraft technology mod built around the custom material ayzium.*

---

## 🌌 What It Adds

Ayzium introduces a suite of electrical and security-based devices powered by ayzium, including:

- Electroshockers crafted from ayzium, copper, and brass
- Forcefield generators for advanced base protection
- Lore-friendly lighting systems
- Player detection and signal-based automation tools
- Raw Ayzium mining and refinement process

---

## ⚡ Why Download It?

This mod is designed for players who want full control over their base's security and signal infrastructure. It’s perfect if you love redstone-style logic, creative automation, and mythic tech themes. Key benefits include:

- Unique tech tree centered around ayzium
- Advanced protection mechanics and access control
- Visual diagnostic tools for signal routing
- Modular systems with zero external dependencies

---

## 📋 Critical Info Before Installing

- 🧱 Requires a modern Minecraft loader
- 🔧 Redstone knowledge helpful but not required
- 🧭 Built for low friction integration with existing mods
- 🌐 English description included; localized versions may be added
- 📄 No dependencies — just drop it in and start crafting

---

> Ayzium is ideal for builders, modders, and tech enthusiasts who want to expand their gameplay with secure, lore-driven circuitry. Let your imagination power your fortress.
